programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

programme.title: Contagion
programme.desc: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

programme.title: Repo Men
programme.desc: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

programme.title: Repo Men

programme.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
programme.desc: Magical Nanny McPhee helps a harried mother who is trying to care for five children and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war.

programme.title: Hidden Figures

programme.title: Lord of the Flies
programme.desc: English schoolboys (James Aubrey, Tom Chapin, Hugh Edwards), stranded on a desert island without adults, soon turn savage.

programme.title: The Darkest Minds
programme.desc: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. Betrayed by the adults in power, they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

programme.title: Dumb Money

programme.title: X-Men: First Class
programme.desc: Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr work with other mutants to prevent a nuclear nightmare, but a situation soon tears the close friends apart.

programme.title: Broken City
programme.desc: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe).

programme.title: The Alto Knights

programme.title: The Art of Getting By

programme.title: Black Butterfly
programme.desc: A down-on-his luck screenwriter picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay, not knowing that soon he'll become a prisoner, forced to write for a deranged stranger.

programme.title: They All Laughed
programme.desc: New York private eyes (Ben Gazzara, John Ritter) fall for wives they've been hired by husbands to follow.

programme.title: The Dilemma

programme.title: MacGruber

programme.title: Mojave

programme.title: Arctic

programme.title: Spring Breakers

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter.
